question: The International Conference on Soil and Water Resources Management for Climate was organised in November 2019 in __________ to deliberate upon the various issues and challenges of soil and water conservation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The International Conference on Soil and Water Resources Management for Climate** was organised in **November 2019 in New Delhi** to deliberate on the various issues and challenges of soil and water conservation.
 
• **The five-day "International Conference on Soil and Water Resources Management for Climate Smart Agriculture and Global Food and Livelihood Security"** was launched at the National Agricultural Science Centre Complex in New Delhi by **Dr Trilochan Mohapatra, Secretary (DARE) & Director General (ICAR).**
 
• With the aim of discussing the various problems and difficulties associated with soil and water conservation, the conference was jointly organised by the **Soil Conservation Society of India, World Association of Soil and Water Conservation (WASWAC), China and the International Soil Conservation Organization (ISCO), United States.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In order to protect productive and sustainable agriculture, Dr. Mohapatra addressed his concerns regarding the deterioration of soil and water resources.
 
• According to him, the steadily rising temperature of the climate is a serious issue since it has a profound impact on human life.
 
• He believed that the catastrophic climate changes were primarily caused by numerous human activities.
 
• He also advised **people to take a number of steps to lessen the effects of climate change. **
